instruction: report.py fails on Python <3.12 because it uses a nested-quote f-string `f"{d["k"]}"`. Rewrite it compatibly (no nested same-quote f-strings) so it runs under this interpreter and writes report.txt containing 'count=3'.
setup:
cat > report.py <<'EOF'
data = {'k': 'count', 'v': 3}
line = f"{data['v']}"
open('report.txt','w').write(f"count={line}\n")
EOF
cat > check.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
python3 -c "import ast,sys; t=ast.parse(open('report.py').read()); src=open('report.py').read(); assert 'f\"' not in src or sys.version_info>=(3,12)" || exit 1
EOF

grader.script: python3 report.py && grep -qx 'count=3' report.txt && ! grep -q 'f"{data\[' report.py

oracle.script:
cat > report.py <<'EOF'
data = {'k': 'count', 'v': 3}
line = str(data['v'])
open('report.txt','w').write('count=' + line + '\n')
EOF
python3 report.py
